paragraphs: R. Yoshiyah of Hutzal. Rav Kahana went to Hutzal and saw a certain man, etc. He said to him, “This man, etc.” Rav Kahana told him, “You are from R. Yoshiyah's place”; therefore you are expert in laws, because R. Yoshiyah of Hutzal expounded publicly and instructed them. He applied to him, “The righteous man is the foundation of the world”: Gittin 61a. Hutzal is in Babylonia, near Nehardea: the synagogue, near Ezra's study house. “Beit Almin of Hutzal”: some explain it as a place-name; others as a cemetery, since “man goes to his eternal house.”
